tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Lefschetz number of surface rotation] ↗ thm:lefschetz-fixed-point 1. ch2:2C.4\group Singular Homology

For the fixed-point-free half-turn of a genus-three orientable surface, the induced maps contribute $1$ in dimension $0$, $-2$ in dimension $1$, and $1$ in dimension $2$, so $\tau =0$. \end{example}
